visual_action: The video opens with a two-panel still image. The top panel shows Senator Bernie Sanders, and the bottom shows Robert F. Kennedy Jr., both in what appear to be hearing rooms. After a fast spinning transition, a quick montage of photos of RFK Jr. is shown: one of him swimming in a creek with two children, one of him posing with a dead bear cub, and a final close-up of his face. A sparkling filter effect is applied to the final image as it fades to black.

cast.name: Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
cast.evidence: He is shown in multiple photos and is the subject of all on-screen text after the opening shot, culminating in a mocking claim about him.

cast.name: Bernie Sanders
cast.evidence: Appears in the top panel of the opening image, with an on-screen text quote attributed to him, to create a contrast with RFK Jr.

on_screen_text.text: Is health care a human right?
I can't give you a yes or no to that.
RFK Jr. posts photos swimming with his family in DC's Rock Creek despite warnings of high bacteria
PHOTO EMERGES OF RFK JR. POSING WITH DEAD BEAR CUB
a dead worm in his brain 🥰

spoken_summary: The audio consists of edited clips from JoJo Siwa's version of the song "Bette Davis Eyes." The video uses the lyrics "she's got" to align with on-screen text that begins "he's got," setting up the visual punchline "a dead worm in his brain." The song's final lyric, "Bette Davis eyes," plays over the end of the video.
audio_music: An upbeat, electronic pop track (JoJo Siwa's cover of "Bette Davis Eyes") plays throughout. The song is edited to isolate lyrical fragments, creating a build-up to a textual punchline, which gives the video a mocking and satirical tone.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage using still images and a spinning transition. The edits are timed to the lyrics of the background music to create a comedic, punchline-driven structure.
manipulation_or_satire: A sparkling glitter effect is superimposed over a close-up photo of Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s face at the end of the video. This visual filter is used for mocking effect, timed with the on-screen text "a dead worm in his brain 🥰".
cultural_references: The song "Bette Davis Eyes", specifically the cover by JoJo Siwa.
Bette Davis, the actress referenced in the song title.
central_claim: Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is a bizarre, reckless, and evasive political candidate who is unfit for office, as evidenced by a series of negative news stories and a report about a parasite in his brain.
intended_effect: To ridicule Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and persuade viewers that he is an unserious and unfit candidate.
